name: cn.dianyinhuoban.szg.mvp.order.view.PayInfoActivity
description: The Dianyinhuoban SHENGZHANGUI (DY_SZG) business SDK opens offline-payment instructions after an order selects that payment route. It shows payment details and lets the user upload a payment voucher.
disableEffect: Disabling it breaks the offline-payment and voucher-submission flow.
